successors.name: New Netherland
successors.text: New Sweden on the Delaware: Fort Christina and the settlements 'on both sides of the Delaware River'

ledger.x: 1638: the Swedes land at The Rocks on the Christina River and build Fort Christina.
1643: Fort Nya Elfsborg is built on the Delaware's east bank.
1654 (May): New Sweden strikes at the Dutch.
1654 (May): Fort Casimir falls to the Swedes under Johan Risingh and is renamed Fort Trinity.
1655 (15 September): Fort Christina surrenders and New Sweden is lost to the Dutch.

wars.name: Dutch-Swedish conflict on the Delaware (1654-1655)
wars.outcome: Dutch victory: the Swedes took Fort Casimir in May 1654; Stuyvesant retook it in summer 1655 and Fort Christina surrendered on 15 September 1655, ending New Sweden.
